note: Open source software authored by Alex Merced. Categories map to the agent-infrastructure and lakehouse-tooling topic clusters. Repository URLs are verified against their configured git remotes.

categories.agent-infrastructure: Harnesses, memory systems, and specifications for AI agents.
categories.lakehouse-tooling: Catalogs, engines, and libraries for working with lakehouse data.

projects.name: Pangolin
projects.tagline: A Rust-based, multi-tenant, Iceberg-compatible lakehouse catalog.
projects.description: Pangolin is a high-performance lakehouse catalog written in Rust. It supports Git-style branching, multi-tenancy, federated catalogs, and tracks any lakehouse asset type. Status: alpha.

projects.name: IceFrame
projects.tagline: A DataFrame-like Python library for Apache Iceberg tables over REST catalogs.
projects.description: IceFrame provides a DataFrame-style API for creating, reading, updating, and deleting Apache Iceberg tables through REST catalogs with local execution, plus table maintenance and export operations. Status: alpha.

projects.name: Loro
projects.tagline: A Python CLI agent harness for enterprise coding, governed data work, and productivity tasks.
projects.description: Loro is a Python CLI agent harness built for enterprise coding, governed data work, and productivity tasks. The name is Spanish for parrot: a bird that listens, learns, repeats useful knowledge, and helps information move across groups.

projects.name: MagAgent
projects.tagline: A terminal-native AI coding agent with persistent memory.
projects.description: MagAgent is a terminal-native AI coding agent with persistent memory, built for developers who want an assistant that learns their codebase and habits over time. It anchors a local-first AI productivity stack alongside MagGraph and Mag Command Center.

projects.name: MagGraph
projects.tagline: Rust-powered Markdown graph memory with search, backlinks, and recall bundles.
projects.description: MagGraph provides Markdown-based graph memory for AI agents: search, backlinks, recall bundles, and Python bindings, implemented in Rust. The name is short for Magpie, a corvid known for memory and tool use.

projects.name: Mag Command Center
projects.tagline: Cross-platform desktop app for managing MagAgent projects, agents, and memory.
projects.description: Mag Command Center is a cross-platform desktop application for managing MagAgent projects, agents, memory, plugins, and local productivity workflows. It is a UI over the installed magent CLI and shares the same configuration, MagGraph memory, and plugins used from the terminal.

projects.name: Agentic Graph Specification
projects.tagline: An open, implementation-neutral format for decomposing a project into a graph of agentic loops.
projects.description: The Agentic Graph Specification (AGS) defines an open, implementation-neutral format for decomposing a project into a directed acyclic graph where every node is a bounded agentic loop, one unit of work an AI agent runs end to end, and every edge is a control-flow dependency.

projects.name: SencilloDB
projects.description: SencilloDB is a lightweight database library published to npm.

projects.name: MercedTodo
projects.tagline: A CLI and TUI todo list manager written in Python.
projects.description: MercedTodo is a command line and terminal UI todo list manager written in Python.

projects.name: Lakehouse Tools
projects.tagline: Utilities for working with lakehouse data.
projects.description: A collection of utilities for lakehouse and catalog work.

projects.name: ContainerMaker
projects.description: ContainerMaker helps generate and manage container configurations.
